**The document doesn't say. It never applies SimPO to Llama-3-70B.**

Llama-3-70B appears only once, as a reference entry from the AlpacaEval 2 leaderboard. In Table 1, the untuned **Llama-3-70B-Instruct** has a 34.4% LC win rate, a 33.2% raw win rate and an average length of 1919 (page 2). The bold entries in that table are the models the authors trained, and Llama-3-70B is not one of them (page 2).

The paper does apply SimPO to these models:

- **Llama-3-8B-Instruct:** 44.7% LC win rate (Table 4, page 6; Table 1, page 2). With the stronger ArmoRM reward model (v0.2), this rises to 53.7% (Table 12, page 29).
- **Llama-3-8B-Base:** 22.0% LC win rate (Table 4, page 6).
- **Gemma-2-9B-it:** 72.4% LC win rate, the paper's top result (Table 1, page 2; Table 17, page 32).
